name: Follow-ups
description: Keeps track of commitments and prepares follow-ups.

role.line: Keeps track of commitments and prepares follow-ups
brings: Skills for tracking promises and drafting follow-ups
A scorecard you check every Friday

wins.say: Here is everything I said I would do this week.
What have I promised someone that has gone quiet?
Sweep every weekday morning and tell me what has gone cold.

offers.title: Morning sweep
offers.detail: Each weekday, what has gone cold and what is due
offers.instruction: Read the open rows in commitments. List what is overdue, then what is due in the next two days, owner by owner, and draft a follow-up for anything a week late using the draft-follow-up skill. Send nothing yourself.
